title: Crypto traders value Anthropic at $1.9 trillion as investor warns its IPO could mark the top of the AI bubble
summary: Anthropic filed for a Nasdaq IPO Monday, reporting a quarterly operating profit as crypto markets valued it near $2 trillion. The Claude developer submitted its S-1 registration statement to the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Oct. 26, seeking a listing under the ticker ANT.
